title: 25 Years of Depression: The Pastor Who Said NO to Help #shorts

top_liked.author: @singingsiren82
top_liked.text: I dealt with severe depression as a child... my mom told me it was God's gift of feeling the pain of the world... looking back it's such a wild take.

top_liked.author: @homophilosofikus8215
top_liked.text: Americans like to claim they have the best healthcare in the world. But when it comes to ordinary people it seems they are reduced to "hopes and prayers", that`s not health OR care

top_liked.author: @mm-rj3vo
top_liked.text:
Not having the words, being forced to use other words, forced not by malice but by an extremity of false hope 

Hope, now, that exists within you and outside of you, interspersed throughout your communities of care and joy 

This resonates with me, at least 

I have more hope…
